Interface SimConstants

public interface SimConstants
Constants used by QueueNet package. Modified by Ashanka (May 2010): Patch: Multi-Sink Perf. Index Description: Added new Performance index for capturing 1. global response time (ResponseTime per Sink) 2. global throughput (Throughput per Sink) each sink per class.
